name: zmodel_instance_update_scrolling_textures
description: zModel_Instance::UpdateScrollingTextures applies per-frame U/V scroll deltas to polygon UVs and wraps the updated UV range back into the renderer texture extent.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Binary Ninja still has x87 fst/fstp flag-lifting warnings in the min/max scan, so the functional target records behavior evidence and leaves tier S open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4791c0 validates the no-op path for zero scroll rates, g_FrameDeltaTimeSec scaling, U/V min/max tracking across zClipUV entries, renderer-dependent wrap extent of 2048 or 128 shifted by texture wrap fields, floor/ceil based wrap correction, and per-axis correction of every UV entry.
The native zModel smoke verifies ordinary U/V scrolling, renderer-path wrap correction for U, and the shared scrolling-texture helper used by the per-instance update wrapper.
